Michelin tyre dealer in Bukit Indah, Johor Bahru

New tyres, puncture repair and replacement sets, fitted in our own bay.

WhatsApp usCall us

Overseas Tyre is listed on the Michelin Malaysia dealer locator for Johor Bahru. We supply and fit Michelin tyres, and we also supply Continental tyres and sport rims.

Not sure of your size? Send a photo of the tyre sidewall or just your car model and year on WhatsApp. We will tell you what fits and check stock before you drive in.

Every tyre is fitted on our Hunter tyre changer and each wheel is balanced before it goes back on the car. If your car pulls or the new set wears unevenly, ask us to set the alignment in the same visit.

Recent work in our bay

How a tyre job goes

Four steps, one visit.

  1. WhatsApp us

    Send your car model and year, and your tyre size if you have it.

  2. We inspect and recommend

    We check your tyres and wheels, then tell you what you need and why.

  3. Fit, balance and align

    New tyres go on the Hunter changer, each wheel is balanced, then the alignment is set.

  4. Collect your car

    We show you what was done, you pay and drive off.
